result.summary: Found 3 visible issues: one clear invalid data value and two horizontal-content clipping problems.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card shows an invalid delivery price: "€NaN delivery".
issues.suggestion: Validate and format delivery-fee data before rendering; show a valid fee, "Free delivery," or omit the fee if unavailable.

issues.description: The rightmost restaurant card in the "Fastest near you" horizontal carousel is cut off, including its image, name, and delivery text.
issues.suggestion: Use a properly bounded horizontal carousel with intentional peek spacing, or ensure cards and text remain fully visible within the viewport.

issues.description: The category-chip row is clipped at the right edge, leaving a partially visible next chip without enough visual breathing room.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side padding to the horizontal chip scroller and ensure clipped items have deliberate, consistent peek behavior.
